component.name: Zypp Desk
component.summary: Every zypper feature in a window
Totes les funcions de zypper en una finestra
Alle Funktionen von zypper in einem Fenster
Toutes les fonctions de zypper dans une fenêtre

description.p: Zypp Desk is a graphical front end for zypper, the package manager of openSUSE, that keeps the whole power of zypper and always shows the exact command and zypper's own output.

ul.li: Search, install and remove packages, upgrade the distribution, with a simulation first
Your applications in one list, from the repositories, from Flatpak or from the web
Discover programs by theme in the openSUSE and Flathub catalogues
Follow programs installed from files published on the web and get their new versions
Repositories with a health check, locks, languages, history and maintenance
Warnings explained in plain words, with how serious they are

description.p: Questions in plain words with the exact commands underneath, a clearer queue review, a big upgrade that asks whether it is worth waiting, upgrades in parts when the disk is nearly full, dependency problems grouped by cause, bridge packages for RPMs made for Fedora, and repositories for Fedora that zypper did not see.

Fixes from a review from six points of view: safer solutions to dependency problems and dup window, one transaction for removals and installs, key imports that cannot hide a second key, a refresh timer that works on a laptop that suspends, repository address changes that never lose the repository, and many interface and translation fixes.

A tray icon that tells you about updates, firmware updates through fwupd, the history with snapper snapshots and undo, solutions to dependency problems in plain words, signing keys, the settings of zypp.conf, a graphical routine editor, repository priorities with a suggested order, new addresses for repositories that moved, opening downloaded RPM files, and removing what only a package needed.
Routines run zypper without questions, programs from the web can be simulated, and fixes from a review.
Applications by origin, discover by theme, more kinds of web source, repository health check and an online search in the openSUSE Build Service, Fedora COPR and Flathub.
German and French translations, and fixes from a review.
